immutable_readback.method: Read exact candidate blobs, compare base contents, then verify all 11 reviewed blob SHAs against the immutable source Git tree. No working-tree execution or runtime validation is implied.

checks.action_and_permission_preservation: The refresh, act, canChangeCaptureMode, changeCaptureMode, toolAction and checkForUpdates function bodies are unchanged from the base. Backend/public API, observed-state gates, explicit Start, capture privacy and microphone intent remain unchanged.
checks.private_configuration_disclosure: Saved destination and connection controls collapse progressively. Hiding destination settings clears key/password drafts, invalidates the clipboard epoch, closes confirmation modals, resets public drafts and is refused during a pending mutation. Ordinary polling does not reopen a saved editor; first-run setup opens on the unconfigured transition. Public configuration projection and mutation checks are unchanged.
checks.guide_navigation: Only an own-property key from the fixed public provider inventory reaches browser navigation. Sync and async navigation errors become generic feedback; no account data, private destination or token is passed to the navigation helper.
checks.media_list_states: Clip loading, positive empty, populated and failed results are distinct. Malformed/incomplete lists cannot establish an empty library. Only named display fields are projected. List request generation is separate from media-action serials; hiding discards late results.
checks.clip_pending_lifetime: Local React loading state and the imperative pending ref cover the complete list promise, including the awaited final status refresh. Closed Browse and Refresh remain disabled until settlement; Hide remains available. Unmount guards prevent late React state writes.
checks.health_and_recovery_feedback: Generic request failures remain visible outside collapsed health details. A returned recovery request is not presented as proof of recovered output or a streaming success.
checks.optional_desktop_instructions: The referenced setup.py is included by the existing plugin shared-file inventory and implements authenticated loopback-only setup with a private session token. Instructions introduce no new server, mandatory companion or unauthenticated LAN service.
checks.tsx_and_types_scope: Imports, local state shapes, JSX fragment nesting and callback use are consistent on manual source inspection. This is not a TypeScript compiler, JSX parser, native Decky API or render test.
checks.test_scope: Existing state/privacy assertions remain. New model/browser fixtures address guide errors, clip validity and delayed list states, secret disposal and late clipboard completion, narrow primary-control order, focus, collapsed failures and the pending-through-final-refresh race. Test source inspection is not test execution.
checks.identity_and_scope: The original 230-criterion ledger, product metadata, compatibility IDs, selected concept records and PNG blobs remain unchanged. Selected aurora production source, lowercase display adoption, logo integration, exports and rights facts remain pending under open work #80/#81.
